about.intro: Tidy shows the weather where you are — right now, hour by hour, and a week ahead — without an account, ads or a setup flow. Here is what each panel on that screen is for.

now.body: Tidy asks once for your location and opens on it: temperature, what it actually feels like, humidity, wind, pressure and visibility. Search any city to look somewhere else.

night.body: Sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset for whichever day you are viewing, so you know how much light is left before you head out.

week.body: A week of highs, lows and rain chance as cards. Pick any day and the rest of the screen follows it — the same detail you get for today, for next Tuesday.

air.body: Air quality and UV index, read back as plain words instead of raw index numbers: good, moderate, unhealthy. Worth a look before a long run or an afternoon outside.

hours.body: The day's temperature as a single curve. See when the heat peaks and when it drops, and time the walk, the ride or the laundry around it.

about.settingsNote: Tidy also speaks বাংলা, switches between °C and °F, and follows your system's light or dark theme. Change any of it from Settings.

errors.geolocationUnsupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser
